Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 17:12:00 +0000
Subject: Pilot purchase + payment terms (Net45 for EU entity)

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the demo last week — Greenfield is excited to proceed with a small 3-month pilot for clinical summarization across two hospitals. Procurement asked me to confirm billing terms up front so we can route the PO.

Two items to confirm:
- Can Redwood accept Net45 for the EU billing entity (we're subject to reverse-charge VAT and prefer a longer remit window to align with our monthly AR run).
- Because our internal PO approvals take 2–3 weeks, would Redwood consider a temporary credit corridor to cover the first two invoice cycles while the PO is in the system?

I attach our PO stub (PO_Greenfield_HF-001.pdf) for reference.

If it helps, here are the procurement contacts: Tom Jacobs (tom.jacobs@greenfield.health) and procurement@greenfield.health. We can share our VAT ID and legal billing name once you confirm how you'd like the invoice emitted (reverse-charge vs Redwood billing VAT).

Best,
Anna Morales
Head of Procurement
Greenfield Health

Anna —

Really appreciate the quick follow-up and the PO stub. Glad to hear the pilot is moving forward. High level proposal from our side:

- Billing cadence: We can issue the first invoice on activation with Net30 standard, then move to Net45 for subsequent invoices for your EU billing entity if you provide the VAT ID and confirm reverse-charge treatment.
- Temporary credit corridor: We can offer a limited pilot credit corridor to bridge the PO approval lag. Finance (cc Marissa) will need to approve the amount — my initial ask is a ~€75k corridor to cover usage spikes during month 1–2.
- Documentation: I'll attach a redline of our MSA with a brief credit addendum for your procurement/legal to review.

Marissa — can you confirm whether finance can temporarily open the corridor and what gating docs we need (signed PO, VAT ID, org chart, etc.)?

Anna — once we have Marissa's confirmation I'll route the DocuSign link and propose the invoice emission format.

Thanks,

Hi Dylan / Anna,

Finance has reviewed and we can support a temporary credit corridor for the pilot with the following guardrails:

1) Amount & duration: Up to €75,000 available as a temporary corridor for 60 days post-MSA signature.
2) Invoicing cadence: We prefer Net30 as our default. However, for EU entities where reverse-charge applies, we can accept Net45 on a case-by-case basis once we receive the VAT registration number and confirm the billing entity.
3) Required docs to enable corridor: signed PO (or signed SOW), completed credit addendum (attached draft), company VAT ID, and a contact for remittance/AR. If Greenfield uses a central purchasing entity for multiple hospitals, we need the legal name and VAT number for the invoiced legal entity.
4) Controls: Corridor is an interim facility. If usage exceeds the corridor before the PO clears, we will alert procurement and can pause consumption until payment/PO is in place.

Please review the attached CreditAddendum_Greenfield_draft.pdf and let us know if Tom / procurement can supply the VAT ID and confirm legal billing entity. Once we have that, I can approve the corridor and Dylan will send a DocuSign route for the MSA + addendum.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
